reviewMethod: Read the captured English blocks and six chronological samples from every available front/side source clip for these 16 exercises: 56 clips, 336 frame samples. Twelve exercises have male and female clips; four have female clips only. Corrections are editorial descriptions grounded in the observed load, stance and movement, not recovered provider wording. Preserve existing numeric cues and illustrative left/right sequences; do not add load, rep, set, angle or platform-height prescriptions.
databaseStatus: Applied and verified against all 1946 source rows and 1792 pre-existing translations, including the eight metadata revisions. Only steps of the 16 selected sources changed; source timestamps, media, categories and favorite counts preserved.

before.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift
steps: Start by standing on one leg with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two dumbbells.
From this starting position, hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once you feel a stretch in your hamstring, slowly return to the starting position.
Make sure to keep your standing leg slightly bent and avoid rounding your back as you lower the dumbbell.

after.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg, holding one dumbbell in each hand, and lift your other foot off the floor.
Hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbells towards the ground as your lifted leg extends behind you, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once you feel a stretch in your hamstring, slowly return to the starting position.
Make sure to keep your standing leg slightly bent and avoid rounding your back as you lower the dumbbells.

evidence.written_source_status: Captured source instructions were reviewed from the existing inventory; no new provider wording is claimed. Corrections are editorial based on every available source video sample sequence.
evidence.observation: Both genders balance on one foot while the other leg extends behind them during the hinge, with one dumbbell in each hand. Replace the contradictory simultaneous one-leg/shoulder-width stance and clarify that both dumbbells lower. Retain the source's slightly bent standing knee and controlled return.
evidence.sampling: Six chronological samples per video at fps=6/sample_window_seconds; all available genders and both angles inspected; four sources have female clips only. Each clip was sampled across its recorded full duration.

before.name: Plate Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold the plate at chest height close to your body
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

before.name: Dumbbell Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.
